title: Rory and the Starlit Cedar Hollow
verses:
The moon rose up high over mountain and hill,
The wind in the branches was tender and still.
Then Rory walked out where the cedar trees grow,
And watched all the shadows drift softly below.

Far up in the dark, Nia glided in flight,
To guide every friend through the welcoming night.
And Ricky raced up with a hop and a bound,
Then quietly settled upon the cool ground.

Now Tilly stepped forward with comforting grace,
To help find a peaceful and welcoming place.
And Benny walked up with a thud and a sigh,
As clouds floated past in the lavender sky.

Then Psittaco chirped from a bundle of green,
The coziest shelter that ever was seen.
The stars twinkled down with a shimmering glow,
While cool evening breezes blew gentle and slow.

Now Ricky curled up on a pillow of moss,
Where ribbons of starlight had drifted across.
And Nia tucked gently her wings by her side,
As Benny lay down where the shadows were wide.

Then Rory lay down for a slumber so deep,
And let the soft darkness invite him to sleep.
The stars shone like lanterns in heaven above,
And wrapped all the friends in a blanket of love.
